 Horticultural Seedling Production Ahead of the Rainy Season
 19th November 2026 17:35 GMT+7
 Workers care for chili seedlings at the Sukomaju nursery center, Banyuwangi, East Java, Thursday (19/11/2026). Horticultural seedling cultivators in the area recorded that during the dry season, horticultural seedling production such as vegetables, fruits, and medicinal plants usually only reaches 50 percent or 382,500 seedlings from the maximum capacity of 765,000 seedlings. This has now increased to almost full capacity in line with the high demand ahead of the rainy season. ANTARA FOTO/Budi Candra Setya/agr
